decision: The q=38038 compensation is visible in exact source-pair cross terms.  Its middle bucket alone is about -0.939993, but non-middle buckets add about +0.092700; the top four non-middle cross terms, all from the mirror block (143,266)/(266,143), supply more than 80 percent of that positive non-middle sum.  Q=46189 has negative aggregate non-middle contribution instead. This supports a mirror-source-pair compensation theorem target, but proves no such theorem and no Goldbach result.
